root_cause.text: In the OCFS2 filesystem, a deadlock arose because `ocfs2_dio_end_io_write` acquired the `ip_alloc_sem` before the orphan directory `inode_lock`, creating an ABBA lock ordering violation against `ocfs2_unlink` which acquires these locks in the reverse order.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff relocates `down_write(&oi->ip_alloc_sem)` in `ocfs2_dio_end_io_write` to occur after `ocfs2_del_inode_from_orphan`, aligning the lock acquisition sequence with `ocfs2_unlink` to prevent the circular wait condition described in the CVE description.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fixes a race condition by acquiring the inode allocation semaphore before modifying the dinode extent tree during direct I/O write completion.
intent_record.what: Added down_write(&oi->ip_alloc_sem) call before accessing the dinode buffer.
intent_record.how: Acquires an exclusive lock on the inode allocation semaphore to serialize access to the dinode extent tree during write completion.
